usable_automated.rule: at least one AI variant accepted by the validator (grounded, format, evidence, not a near-duplicate) that fits three hook lines

grounding_note: An earlier build also checked the first word of a hook against the episode's lower-case vocabulary: it dropped 36 AI hooks on these 32 clips and every one of those first words was a common word (Rahasia, Cara, Sisi, Alasan, ...). The plan's rule (capitalised non-initial tokens) is used, plus acronyms and inner capitals anywhere.
